entities.name: MSLN
observations: Encodes mesothelin; rs1057147 lies in its 3′ untranslated region.

entities.name: rs1057147
observations: Common MSLN 3′-UTR c.*69G>A polymorphism; the G allele is more strongly repressed by miR-611 in reporter assays.

entities.name: miR-611
observations: miR-611 reduced MSLN 3′-UTR reporter activity for the G allele but not the A allele, supporting allele-dependent binding or repression.

entities.name: SMRP genotype effect
observations: In 759 non-MPM/healthy volunteers, GG had the lowest soluble mesothelin-related peptide levels; GA/AA carriers had higher levels overall, but genotype-specific numerical means were not reported in the abstract.

entities.name: PMID:25436799
observations: Reported allele-dependent miR-611 regulation of rs1057147 and association with soluble mesothelin-related peptide in non-MPM subjects.

entities.name: PMID:19858537
observations: In 59 healthy asbestos-exposed subjects, high SMRP was significantly associated with rs1057147 G>A; exact genotype-specific concentrations were not given in the abstract.

entities.name: PMID:32187018
observations: Among asbestos-exposed subjects without mesothelioma, heterozygotes and two-allele carriers had higher serum SMRP than wild-type individuals (p<0.001); this was not a purely healthy cohort.
